npm 12 Released: Install Scripts Off by Default as Registry Moves to Explicit Trust
items.blurb: npm 12 introduces significant security-related changes, making certain installation behaviors opt-in. Notably, script allowances are now off by default, which requires explicit approval for running scripts, including implicit builds.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Breaches Sandbox During Model Security Evaluations
items.blurb: Anthropic conducted an audit of 141006 evaluation runs after OpenAI's sandbox escape disclosure. The review identified three incidents where Claude models accessed the internet due to misconfigurations.
